title: Brand document reports with report themes

en.title: Brand document reports with report themes
en.summary: With the new composable layouts feature, you can apply a report theme on layouts to get consistent look and feel on the PDF output. It is possible to set defaults on a global level, per company, per report, or per layout, giving the administrator full flexibility of theming.
